title: New Rapid Test Changes Brain Tumour Diagnosis
subtitle: Doctors can now identify brain cancer in just two hours, significantly speeding up life-saving treatment.

summary.en: A new medical test is changing how doctors diagnose brain tumours. Developed by the University of Nottingham, the test provides results in two hours instead of eight weeks. It works by analyzing the genetic code of a tumour sample during surgery. The NHS is currently testing this tool in five specialist centres across the UK. Experts believe this technology will save lives by allowing for faster treatment decisions.
summary.zh: 一項新的醫療檢測技術正在改變醫師診斷腦瘤的方式。這項由諾丁漢大學開發的技術，能將診斷結果的等待時間從八週縮短至兩小時。其運作原理是在手術期間分析腫瘤樣本的基因密碼。英國國民保健署目前正在全英五家專科中心測試此工具。專家認為，這項技術能讓醫師更快做出治療決策，進而挽救更多生命。

paragraphs.en: A major breakthrough in medical technology is set to change how doctors treat brain tumours. According to The Guardian Health, a new rapid test can now identify the type of brain cancer while a patient is still in the operating room. This development is being described by scientists as a "gamechanger" that could help patients who do not have much time to wait for answers.
paragraphs.zh: 醫療技術的一項重大突破即將改變醫師治療腦瘤的方式。根據《衛報健康版》（The Guardian Health）報導，一項全新的快速檢測技術現在能在病患還在手術室時，就辨識出腦癌的類型。科學家將此發展形容為一項「改變遊戲規則」的創舉，能為那些無法久候診斷結果的病患提供極大幫助。

paragraphs.en: In the past, patients often had to wait up to eight weeks to receive a diagnosis after a biopsy, which is a procedure where a small piece of tissue is removed for testing. This long waiting period can be very difficult for patients and their families. The new method, developed by the Brain Tumour Research Centre of Excellence at the University of Nottingham, reduces this waiting time to just two hours. By providing results while the patient is still on the operating table, surgeons can make better decisions about the next steps of care immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 過去，病患在進行切片檢查（即取出少量組織進行檢測的程序）後，往往需要等待長達八週才能獲得診斷結果。這段漫長的等待期對病患及其家屬而言非常煎熬。由諾丁漢大學（University of Nottingham）腦瘤卓越研究中心所開發的新方法，將等待時間縮短至僅需兩小時。透過在病患還在手術台上時就提供檢測結果，外科醫師能立即針對後續照護做出更妥善的決策。

paragraphs.en: This new tool is a genomic test. This means it looks at the genetic code—the set of instructions inside living cells—of a tumour sample. According to The Guardian Health, the process involves taking a small piece of tissue from the tumour and placing it into a special machine about the size of a shoebox. This machine, made by Oxford Nanopore, uses a tiny hole called a nanopore to read the DNA molecules. This process reveals the unique genetic makeup of the tumour, which tells doctors exactly what kind of cancer they are dealing with.
paragraphs.zh: 這項新工具屬於基因組檢測。這意味著它會分析腫瘤樣本的基因密碼，也就是活細胞內部的指令集。根據《衛報健康版》報導，檢測過程是從腫瘤中取出少量組織，並放入一台約鞋盒大小的特殊機器中。這台由牛津奈米孔（Oxford Nanopore）公司製造的機器，利用一種稱為奈米孔的微小孔洞來讀取去氧核糖核酸分子。此過程能揭示腫瘤獨特的基因組成，讓醫師精確得知他們所面對的是哪種癌症。

paragraphs.en: Prof Frankie Swords, the medical director for the NHS, stated that this rapid test is a "huge leap forward" for patients. She noted that it has the potential to completely change the way brain tumours are diagnosed. Because the test is so fast, patients can start their treatment much sooner than before. This is especially important because primary brain tumours are the leading cause of cancer deaths in children and adults under the age of 40 in the UK. Starting treatment early can be the difference between life and death for many people.
paragraphs.zh: 英國國民保健署（NHS）醫療主任法蘭琪·史沃茲（Frankie Swords）教授表示，這項快速檢測對病患而言是「一大躍進」。她指出，這項技術有潛力徹底改變腦瘤的診斷方式。由於檢測速度極快，病患能比以往更早開始治療。這點至關重要，因為原發性腦瘤是英國兒童及四十歲以下成人癌症死亡的主要原因。對許多人來說，及早開始治療往往是生與死的關鍵差別。

paragraphs.en: Stuart Smith, a consultant neurosurgeon at Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust, played a key role in creating this technology. He explained that having detailed information about a tumour while a patient is still in surgery is a major improvement. Before this, doctors had to look at samples under a microscope, which was slower and sometimes less accurate. With the new genomic test, doctors can get results that are both faster and more precise.
paragraphs.zh: 諾丁漢大學醫院國民保健署信託基金會（Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust）的神經外科顧問醫師史都華·史密斯（Stuart Smith），在研發此技術的過程中扮演了關鍵角色。他解釋說，能在病患還在手術時就掌握腫瘤的詳細資訊是一項重大改善。在此之前，醫師必須透過顯微鏡觀察樣本，這種方式不僅較慢，有時精確度也較低。有了這項新的基因組檢測，醫師能獲得既快速又精準的結果。

paragraphs.en: Currently, the NHS has begun using this tool in five specialist centres. These include Nottingham University Hospitals, University Hospitals Birmingham, Great Ormond Street Hospital, King’s College Hospital, and Newcastle Hospitals. These centres are part of a pilot program, which is a small-scale trial used to test how well a new system works before it is used everywhere. After this initial phase, the NHS plans to bring the technology to other hospitals in cities including Bristol, Oxford, Leeds, and Manchester.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，國民保健署已開始在五家專科中心使用這項工具。這些中心包括諾丁漢大學醫院、伯明罕大學醫院、大奧蒙德街醫院、國王學院醫院以及紐卡索醫院。這些中心屬於試辦計畫的一環，這是一種小規模的實驗，旨在於全面推廣前測試新系統的運作效能。在初步階段結束後，國民保健署計畫將此技術引進布里斯托、牛津、里茲及曼徹斯特等城市的其他醫院。

paragraphs.en: Beyond just faster surgery, this technology could also help patients get early access to clinical trials. Clinical trials are research studies that test new medical treatments to see if they are safe and effective. By identifying the specific type of tumour quickly, doctors can see if a patient is a good fit for a new, experimental medicine. This gives patients more options when standard treatments might not be enough.
paragraphs.zh: 除了能加速手術流程外，這項技術還能幫助病患更早參與臨床試驗。臨床試驗是測試新醫療方式以確認其安全與有效的研究。透過快速辨識出腫瘤的特定類型，醫師能評估病患是否適合使用新的實驗性藥物。當標準治療效果有限時，這能為病患提供更多選擇。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the introduction of this rapid test represents a significant step forward in cancer care. By removing the uncertainty of long wait times, the medical community hopes to provide better, faster, and more targeted care for those facing a brain tumour diagnosis. As the NHS rolls out this technology to more hospitals, the hope is that many more patients will benefit from these faster results, ultimately leading to better health outcomes across the country.
paragraphs.zh: 總體而言，這項快速檢測的引進代表癌症照護邁出了重要的一步。透過消除漫長等待所帶來的不確定性，醫療界希望能為面對腦瘤診斷的病患提供更好、更快且更具針對性的照護。隨著國民保健署將此技術推廣至更多醫院，各界期盼能有更多病患受惠於這些快速的檢測結果，進而提升全國整體的健康成效。

keyTerms.definitionEn: An event, idea, or procedure that effects a significant shift in the current way of doing or thinking about something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 改變遊戲規則的事物；具有重大影響力的新發明或新策略。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞由 game 和 changer 組成，並非指真的遊戲，而是指能徹底改變現狀的關鍵事物。文中：This development is being described by scientists as a "gamechanger" that could help patients who do not have much time to wait for answers.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A person or thing that is suitable for a particular purpose or situation.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 適合的人選或合適的對象。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（適合），這裡作名詞使用，指病人是否適合參加臨床試驗。文中：By identifying the specific type of tumour quickly, doctors can see if a patient is a good fit for a new, experimental medicine.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To officially introduce a new product or service to the public.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （新產品或服務的）正式推出、推廣。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上有「滾出來」的意思，但在商業或科技語境中指大規模推行。文中：As the NHS rolls out this technology to more hospitals, the hope is that many more patients will benefit from these faster results, ultimately leading to better health outcomes across the country.

sources.name: The Guardian Health
sources.title: ‘Gamechanging’ brain tumour test reduces diagnosis from eight weeks to two hours

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the primary function of the machine developed by Oxford Nanopore?

options.A: To remove the tumour tissue from the patient's brain during surgery.
options.B: To read DNA molecules to identify the specific genetic makeup of a tumour.
options.C: To store tumour samples for up to eight weeks before analysis.
options.D: To provide a visual image of the tumour through a high-powered microscope.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第三段明確指出該機器使用「nanopore」來讀取 DNA 分子，進而揭示腫瘤的獨特遺傳結構。選項 A 錯誤，因為切除腫瘤是外科醫生的工作，而非機器的功能。選項 C 與文章提到的「縮短等待時間」相矛盾。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章第五段提到舊方法才需要顯微鏡，這項新技術則是基因組測試。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of this new technology on clinical trials?

options.A: It ensures that all brain tumour patients will be cured by experimental medicines.
options.B: It makes standard medical treatments for brain cancer completely unnecessary.
options.C: It allows doctors to quickly match patients with experimental treatments based on tumour type.
options.D: It forces patients to participate in research studies immediately after their surgery.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第七段，快速識別腫瘤類型能幫助醫生判斷患者是否適合參與臨床試驗，從而獲得更多治療選擇。選項 A 過度推論，文中並未保證能治癒所有患者。選項 B 錯誤，文中提到的是「當標準治療不足時」提供更多選擇，並非取代標準治療。選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提到強制參與，僅是提供機會。

quiz.question: In the first paragraph, the term 'gamechanger' is used to describe the new rapid test. What does this imply?

options.A: The test is a playful tool used to entertain patients during recovery.
options.B: The test is a significant innovation that fundamentally alters an existing situation.
options.C: The test is a competitive sport played by doctors in the operating room.
options.D: The test is an unreliable method that requires further professional review.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。「Gamechanger」在文中是指一項具有重大影響力、能徹底改變現狀的創新技術。選項 A 將其誤解為遊戲。選項 C 錯誤地將「game」從字面上解釋為運動競技。選項 D 與文章正面的語氣不符，文章強調這是一項突破性的醫療進步，而非不穩定的測試。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article?

options.A: The University of Nottingham has become the only place in the UK to treat brain cancer.
options.B: Brain surgery is now safer because doctors no longer need to perform biopsies.
options.C: New genomic testing technology is improving cancer care by providing faster, more precise results.
options.D: The NHS is planning to stop all traditional cancer research to focus on nanopore technology.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於介紹這項新的基因組檢測技術如何透過縮短診斷等待時間，讓醫生能即時做出決策並提供更精準的治療，這是整篇文章的主旨。選項 A 錯誤，因為文中提到有五個中心在使用。選項 B 錯誤，文中提到 biopsy 依然是獲取樣本的必要過程。選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提到要停止其他研究。
